title: Decision Record
description: Machine-readable Architecture Decision Record. Authors create this file (with decision-id, title, status, narrative) when starting a decisions/<client>/<version>/<decision-id> branch. The .github/workflows/decisions-*.yml chain progressively writes each section. Section property names match the kebab-cased workflow names.

decision-id.description: Unique identifier — must match the JSON file name and the trailing segment of the decision branch name

title.description: Short human-readable title of the decision

narrative.description: Author's narrative of the proposed change. Read by all downstream workflows.

scope-validation.description: Output of the Scope Validation workflow. Permissive shape — Scope Validation produces a deterministic outcome + violation list, not the 4-string section shape.

architecture-review.description: Output of the Architecture Review workflow

referential-integrity.description: Output of the Referential Integrity workflow

strategy-alignment.description: Output of the Strategy Alignment workflow

principles-alignment.description: Output of the Principles Alignment workflow

proponent-analysis.description: Output of the Proponent Analysis workflow

challenger-analysis.description: Output of the Challenger Analysis workflow

section.description: Shared shape for every analysis section produced by a decision workflow.

finding.description: What the workflow observed — the analytical output.

impact.description: Why the finding matters — consequence for the proposed change.

recommendation.description: What the author should do in response to the finding.

rationale.description: Why the recommendation is the right course of action.
